task: explore: new venture earthwork-cut-fill (survey points to exact TIN cut and fill)
errors: Bowyer-Watson with a finite super-triangle lost a convex-hull sliver on one random set (121 of 122 triangles, 0.35 cu ft volume error); caught by a two-TIN closed-form test, fixed with a hull-closing boundary pass and a 40-seed stress test.
Balance sheet showed a phantom truckload from the bisection residual; fixed with a balanced tolerance.
Map coloured whole triangles past the boundary; now draws the clipped pieces.
Push hook rejected the post description (223 chars > 160); shortened in a separate commit.

doc_friction.issue: The post front-matter description limit (160 chars) is enforced by a push hook but not mentioned where posts are asked for; cost one extra commit.
--for-changes needs a merge-base, so on the fresh shallow clone it refuses until `git fetch --depth=40 origin main`; that step could be automatic.

deviations.why: 'Calculators are a poor use of a run' — built a new venture that is calculator-shaped but whose core (Delaunay TIN from a survey file, exact two-surface overlay, balance search) is not something a chatbot reply gives.
deviations.did: Built earthwork-cut-fill with a Qhull differential check instead of deepening a flagship.
deviations.result: Merged-quality tool with exact, independently verified volumes; demand untested.

notes: Explore idea: earthwork cut/fill from survey point files (construction direction). Verification: node tests 30/30; check/differential.py identical triangle sets to SciPy Qhull on 5x800-point state-plane sets, volumes within 6e-14; Chromium smoke (example, balance, no console errors, 380px no overflow); siblings.mjs --check 0 orphans. No agent doc written: README carries Next steps (breaklines, daylight slopes).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: engineer building a Delaunay TIN, exact two-surface volume overlay, balance search, page, explainer and Qhull differential check

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
